semiconductor_relevance: High — Ueki Corporation provides essential gases, materials, and engineering services specifically tailored for the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Ueki Corporation has been a key supplier in the semiconductor industry since 1936, offering high-purity gases, sputtering targets, and cleaning chemicals. They support major foundry and memory manufacturers in Japan with comprehensive gas solutions and engineering services.
capabilities: High-purity sputtering targets for semiconductor manufacturing
Thermal spraying coatings for semiconductor equipment
Bulk and specialty gas supply for semiconductor fabs

regional_presence.Japan: Ueki Corporation operates 26 sales and business offices across Japan, serving major semiconductor manufacturers.
